name: XTC New Energy Materials(Xiamen) Co.,Ltd.
summary: XTC New Energy Materials (Xiamen) Co.,Ltd., alongside its subsidiaries, dedicates itself to the research, manufacturing, and global distribution of cathode materials vital for lithium-ion batteries. The company supplies a diverse range of products, including high-voltage lithium cobalt oxide, as well as high-voltage, high-power, and high-nickel ternary materials. These advanced materials are integral to various applications, notably new energy vehicles, 3C consumer electronic devices, and energy storage solutions. The enterprise was founded in 2016 and is based in Xiamen, China.
